tiers.name: record
tiers.label: Record only — the audio and the cover. An alien could do this.

tiers.name: universal
tiers.label: Universal priors — no Earth knowledge, but assumptions beyond the data.

tiers.name: earth
tiers.label: Earth knowledge — the original slides or their captions. Cheating.

tiers.name: oracle
tiers.label: Oracle — tuned per image against the answer. A headroom measurement.

artifacts.name: pixels
artifacts.what: every decoded pixel of all 156 frames
artifacts.why: decode.py imports numpy, dotclock and sync only; its sole data input is the WAV

artifacts.name: timebase
artifacts.what: per-trace start times, trace period, wow and flutter
artifacts.why: matched filter on the blanking burst, which is in the audio

artifacts.name: dot_clock
artifacts.why: measured from the audio; the cover's trace duration predicts 262.5 independently

artifacts.name: geometry
artifacts.what: isotropy 7.4406 samples per trace-width, picture window, 4:3 span
artifacts.why: the cover states 512 traces, 8.34 ms and 4:3; the circle checks the result

artifacts.name: droop_inverse
artifacts.what: per-channel one-pole inverse, tau from a scene-free probe
artifacts.why: the probe is a content-free region of the record's own signal

artifacts.name: circle_metrics
artifacts.what: axis ratio, radial rms, MTF50 of the calibration frame
artifacts.why: a circle is self-checking; the cover says the first image is one

artifacts.name: colour_grouping
artifacts.what: which frames form a triplet (not which is red)
artifacts.why: three consecutive frames of one scene are detectable by correlation alone

artifacts.name: denoise
artifacts.why: assumes natural-image smoothness; no Earth photograph is consulted

artifacts.name: triplet_fusion
artifacts.what: registration and fusion across the three separations of a slide
artifacts.why: cross-separation agreement is a property of the artifact, not of Earth

artifacts.name: deconvolution
artifacts.what: deconvolution by the measured camera PSF
artifacts.why: the PSF is measured from the record; the inversion prior is generic

artifacts.name: display_rotation
artifacts.what: the quarter turn each image is shown at
artifacts.why: the record encodes no 'up'; measured against published reproductions

artifacts.name: mirror_correction
artifacts.what: which published reproductions are laterally inverted
artifacts.why: decided by matching against our decode; the record is authoritative

artifacts.name: titles
artifacts.why: from the Ozma catalogue and NASA/JPL, or from recognising the subject

artifacts.name: colour_roles
artifacts.what: which separation is red, green and blue
artifacts.why: intended to be tier 0 via the spectrum slides, but they are too faint; currently settled by oceans being blue, which is Earth knowledge

artifacts.name: thumbnails
artifacts.what: the shipped PNG of every frame, as the gallery loads it
artifacts.why: the pixels are tier 0, but their LAYOUT is not: build.py applies Barry's hand-made quarter-turn table before writing the file
artifacts.contamination: 60 of 156 frames get a non-zero quarter turn from barry_tables.json['orientation'], a table made by looking at the pictures. Fix: write the PNG in the decoder's own raster frame and move the turn to display time, where the gallery already applies displayRotate. Requires recomputing displayRotate against unrotated thumbnails, since it is currently measured relative to the baked ones.

artifacts.name: evaluation
artifacts.what: gradient NCC against the original slides, dev / held-out split
artifacts.why: scoring only; no score is fed back into a tier 0 module

artifacts.name: oracle_settings
artifacts.what: per-image decoder settings chosen using the true slide
artifacts.why: measures the headroom a better blind decoder could still win
